name: lokalbot
description: Recall meetings, decisions, and commitments from your Mac's LokalBot library, with source references.

interface.longDescription: Search recorded meetings, read summaries and selected transcript excerpts, review commitments, and prepare for conversations. The library stays on your Mac; requested results pass through Cloudflare to your connected ChatGPT or Codex client. This preview requires an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 15+, LokalBot, Node.js 22.12+, and the foreground companion running while the Mac is awake and online. Separate meeting-library permission in LokalBot is required.
defaultPrompt: Find the meeting where we decided on the caching approach.
What commitments are still open from my recent meetings?
Help me prepare for my next conversation with a colleague.
